name: Honda CRF250X / CRF450X
engine: 249 or 449 cc liquid-cooled four-stroke single, carb, electric start
intro: Honda's enduro versions of the CRF racers. Electric start, wider gearing and a carb that is often re-jetted.
recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
